task: Remembered Roll/Pitch/Yaw display rotation in live and dataset LiDAR views
status: Implemented, locally built and tested in Viewer1.4.0; not published
ui: Both LiDAR views have Point-cloud rotation entry. Degrees [-360,360] with0.01 precision; Apply and remember, Cancel, Zero angles. Both share one local preference restored at next start.
convention: Active right-handed fixed-axis X thenY thenZ; column-vector output=Rz(yaw)*Ry(pitch)*Rx(roll)*sensorPoint. Grid axes remain in the display reference coordinates.
persistence: QSettings DIBULI/PrismViewer key lidar/display_rotation_rpy_degrees_v1, one QVariantList [roll,pitch,yaw]. Invalid/NaN/out-of-range preferences fall back to identity; write failure explicitly warns.
scope: Paint-only cached3x3 matrix. Original buffered points, timestamps, reflectivity, recording, export, IMU and device settings untouched. Existing drag/pan/top/reset remains independent.

tests.controls-final.log: Passed after dialog width adjustment; both buttons/dialog apply/cancel/zero, second-process preference reload and malformed preferences.
tests.math: 90deg per-axis and composed90/90/90 vectors verify direction/order; NaN/infinite/out-of-range rejected. Zero returns original point. Independent pre-rotated reference renders exactly the same image, grid unchanged.
tests.persistence: Test uses temporary INI and separate child process; does not overwrite user preferences.
tests.gui: Actual shared controls used by MainWindow tested in offscreen Qt. Screenshot inspected after final layout adjustment.

limits: macOS build/Qt UI tested; no new Windows/Linux build this turn.
No physical device or sensor stream needed/accessed; receiving/recording/export code unchanged.
No GitHub push, tag, Release or distribution package update in this task.
